selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: Treat the approved Context Pack, scope, page contracts, rough interaction artifacts, and affirmed practices as binding requirements sources; use the requirements interview only for decisions those sources explicitly leave unresolved.

selections.heading: Contract Evolution
selections.text: Preserve one shared interaction grammar while respecting provider-owned capability differences; never create identical client controls that simulate unsupported operations or silently expand backend scope.

selections.heading: Testing Posture
selections.text: Define measurable local performance acceptance only as a documented local benchmark; do not infer or claim a production SLO without an approved production workload, hosting topology, and measurement method.

selections.heading: Contract Evolution
selections.text: Create a permanent compatibility redirect only when an inventoried source maps unambiguously to one canonical target and every retained query value can be safely validated; otherwise use the explicit not-found or gone outcome from the approved retirement inventory.
